note: Private family campground on 300 acres with three small private fishing lakes (boat rentals, swimming), south of Marshall off I-69. Directory listings (not the operator) describe ~272 sites with 20/30-amp electric and water, no sewer, a dump station, a May 1 - Oct 1 season, and seasonal as well as nightly sites. No website of its own (trilaketrails.com does not resolve) and its RoverPass page is unclaimed; phone from its Google listing. --Claude
summary: No operator website or booking engine: trilaketrails.com does not resolve (NXDOMAIN), no Facebook page found, and the RoverPass page in `website` is unclaimed (no Instant/Request to Book, 'Last Updated 11/15/2024', no rates). Google Maps: 'Tri-Lakes Trails Campground', 219 Lyon Lake Rd, 4.3 stars / 215 reviews, phone (269) 781-2297 (matches), open - so the presence rule passes on Google, and price on the RV Life $$ tier. No 2024+ operator rate (RV Life reviewers paid $45-47 in Aug 2023). Cleared directory-only hookups, site count, season, dump and the RoverPass booking claim. Seasonal share unknown (directories say seasonal sites are offered). No gateway within 40 km; the family has not stayed here.
flags: Aggregator link in `website`: https://www.roverpass.com/c/tri-lake-trails-campground-marshall-mi/ is an unclaimed RoverPass listing (not a presence or a price). The operator has no website (trilaketrails.com NXDOMAIN, 2026-10-22); the entry stands only on its Google listing (open, 4.3 / 215 reviews, phone 269-781-2297) plus RV Life's $$ tier. If the park is mostly seasonal it would fail long-stay test 2 (no posted nightly rate, no booking site); its seasonal share is not published anywhere.
